concerns.text: Plan §Unresolved Concerns item 6 claims duplicate contracts were 'consolidated into four schemas', but three stale schema files remain in contracts/: drift_result.schema.yaml, log.schema.yaml, taxonomy.schema.yaml. log.schema.yaml even references 'ATBench' and a fabricated 'timestamp derived deterministically from log_id hash' — remnants of the rejected proxy-dataset draft that contradict the agentdog/safety-v1 data model. Delete these three files so the contracts directory matches the four-schema consolidation the plan asserts.
